user.title: Add a person
user.description: Commute follows one person between their home zone and their work zone. A trip that starts at home counts as a commute on a work day once it clearly heads for work; leaving work always starts the commute home.

data.name: Name
data.vehicle: On the road in a vehicle, guess

data_description.person: Where the person is, from the Home Assistant Companion app on their phone.
data_description.work_days: A trip from home counts as a commute only on these days.
data_description.vehicle: What a vehicle between 25 and 60 km/h is, when nothing else tells: public transport (metro, tram or bus) or a car.
data_description.activity_sensor: The phone's activity sensor: sensor.<phone>_activity on an iPhone, sensor.<phone>_detected_activity on Android. It makes walking, cycling and riding much surer.
data_description.ns_to_work: A route sensor of NS Reisadvies (HACS) from your station to the station near work: gives the train and its delay.
data_description.ns_tracker: NS Reisadvies' train tracker of a route: when it is near the person, they are on that train.

error.same_zone: Home and work must be different zones.
error.no_days: Choose at least one work day.
error.no_zone: This zone has no place (latitude and longitude).
